app.title: Cosmere Trivia
app.tagline: How well do you know the Cosmere?

home.practiceDesc: Pick a world and a difficulty
home.newGameConfirmClassic: Starting a new game will discard the classic game in progress. Continue?
home.newGameConfirmQuick: Starting a new game will discard the quick game in progress. Continue?
home.dailyDesc: 5 questions, the same for everyone today
home.dailyStreak: Days in a row: {n} · keep it going!
home.dailyLocked: You have already played the latest challenge

level.title: Difficulty level
level.easyDesc: Mostly easy questions (a few medium ones if they run out).
level.normalDesc: A mix of easy and medium questions, with a few hard ones.
level.expertDesc: Hard and expert questions only, for rereaders.

lifeline.title: Lifelines
lifeline.rules: Each player gets one of each per game (quick games too). They can’t be used on the final question or in practice, and Atium and Stormlight can’t be combined on the same question.

atium.name: Atium
atium.long: Burn atium and glimpse the future: two wrong answers are removed.

stormlight.name: Stormlight
stormlight.desc: Activate before answering: if you miss, choose again.
stormlight.long: Activate it before answering. If you pick a wrong answer, it is marked and you choose again; the right one isn’t revealed. The clock keeps running. If you use Breath while it’s active, it stays active on the new question.
stormlight.armed: Stormlight active: if you miss, you can choose again.
stormlight.saved: Stormlight heals you! Not that one: pick another answer.

breath.name: Breath
breath.desc: Swaps the question for another from the same world and difficulty.
breath.long: Swaps the question for another one from the same world and difficulty. If there’s none left, it can’t be used.
breath.none: No other question from the same world and difficulty.

lifeline.noCombo: Atium and Stormlight can’t be combined on the same question.

setup.title: New game
setup.timerHint: Running out of time counts as a wrong answer. A question’s time keeps running even if you leave the app.
setup.timerPause: Turn the timer off to pause whenever you like.
setup.fullRoundHint: If someone answers the final question right, the players still to play in that round take their turn; anyone else who gets the final right shares the victory. Everyone gets the same number of turns.

about.title: About
about.body: A Trivial-style quiz about the worlds of Brandon Sanderson’s Cosmere. Play solo or pass the phone around with friends.
about.rule1: Spin the wheel and answer a question about the world it lands on.
about.rule2: Right answer: you earn a charge in that world and spin again. Wrong answer: the turn passes to the next player.
about.rule3: Two charges infuse a gem. The wildcard lets you pick the world.
about.rule4: Infuse every gem, then answer the final question to win.
about.offline: Works offline once loaded. Everything is stored on this device only.
about.disclaimer: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Brandon Sanderson or Dragonsteel. The Cosmere and all related names belong to their respective owners.
about.levelsFinal: The classic game’s final question is medium on Easy, hard on Normal and expert on Hard and Expert.
about.rule5: A random draw decides who starts. After 3 right answers in a row, the turn passes to the next player anyway; playing solo there is no limit.
about.rule6: If the wheel lands on a gem you’ve already infused, you choose another world.
about.rule7: If you miss the final question, the turn passes and you’ll try again, with another question, on your next turn.
about.rule8: With the timer on you have 30 seconds per question; running out counts as a wrong answer. Once a question is shown, its time keeps running even if you leave the app.
about.rule9: Full round (2 or more players, on by default): if someone answers the final right, the players still to play in that round take their turn, and anyone who also gets it right shares the victory.
about.rule10: Games with 2 or more players count as group games and don’t add to your personal stats.

errors.load: Couldn’t load the questions. Check your connection and reload.
errors.noQuestions: No questions available with your current spoiler filter.
errors.fallback: Questions aren’t available in this language yet, so they’re shown in English.
errors.emptyFilter: Your spoiler filter leaves no questions. Select the books you’ve read in Settings.

boot.title: Something went wrong
boot.body: The app couldn’t start. The saved data may be damaged: clearing it usually fixes this (you’ll lose the game in progress, your settings and stats).
boot.confirm: Clear the app’s data? You’ll lose the game in progress, your settings and stats.

onboarding.label: Introduction
onboarding.readHint: Tick the books you’ve read and you’ll only get questions about them. You can change this any time in Settings.
onboarding.noneWarn: With no books ticked there won’t be any questions.
onboarding.ruleWheel: Spin the wheel: it picks the world of your question. On the wildcard, you choose.
onboarding.ruleGems: Each right answer charges that world’s gem; two charges infuse it. Infuse them all and answer the final question to win.
onboarding.ruleLifelines: You get three lifelines per game: Atium removes two wrong answers, Stormlight lets you pick again and Breath swaps the question.
onboarding.startBody: Play solo or pass the phone around. You can see this introduction again from “About”.
onboarding.orPick: Or select only what you’ve read:
onboarding.pickOne: Select at least one book to continue.
onboarding.skippedNoFilter: No spoiler filter: you will get questions from every book. You can change this in Settings.

review.hintGroup: The questions missed in this game, with the right answer. Group games aren’t saved to “My mistakes”.

halfCosmere.name: Half the Cosmere
